rules.label: Leaderboard rows and sticky bottom ad

meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides setlist.fm leaderboard and sticky bottom ads, site stats, news and popular-artist boxes, footer; blur or hide news pictures
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, setlist.fm home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): leaderboard rows and the closable sticky bottom ad in the ads option, statistics strip, news section with previews, popular artists box, footer. Setlist.fm uses Bootstrap-era readable class names (`homePageLeaderBoard`, `adhesion`, `newsHomeFeatured`), not hashed ones, and none depend on English text.

NOT verified: setlist pages (the Spotify/Apple Music and ticket boxes), artist and venue pages, search results, the Add setlist wizard, desktop layout, signed-in states.
